Environmental stress management.label: Trunk painting

Irrigation.label: Postharvest irrigation

Modify Landscape.label: Support and guards

Apply Material to Adjust Soil Condition.pdf_text: apply nutrients like phosphorus and potassium based on soil test, as outlined in the cited guide

Disease management.text: Order virus-tested, true-to-type trees and inspect them on arrival.

Disease management.label: Site-borne pathogens
Disease management.text: Check the site for root rots, rust hosts and nematode-borne viruses.

Disease management.label: Root protection

Irrigation.text: Match rootstock to the soil's water-holding capacity.

Nutrient management.text: Soil test before planting to set liming and base fertiliser.

Orchard floor management.text: Sow a cover crop to stabilise soil before planting.

Pruning & Training.text: Remove unsuitable feathers at planting; avoid heading cuts.

Pruning & Training.label: Tree support
Pruning & Training.text: Install tree support soon after planting.

Soil chemical management.label: Site contamination
Soil chemical management.text: Test the site for salinity and contamination.

Pruning & Training.label: Canopy targets
Pruning & Training.text: Set height, branch number and arm angle targets to fill the allotted space.

Pruning & Training.label: Light pruning
Pruning & Training.text: Prune young trees lightly and keep only the branches the framework needs.

Pruning & Training.label: Forcing branches
Pruning & Training.text: Notch, head or cincture where new laterals or renewal shoots are needed.

Modify Landscape.text: Know when the young block turns from carbon source to sink.

Orchard floor management.text: Up to six cultivations per season may be required.

Orchard floor management.label: Herbicide usage
Orchard floor management.text: Follow herbicide usage guidelines for effectiveness by herbicide type.
Orchard floor management.pdf_text: Refer to herbicide usage guidelines for effectiveness by type.

Orchard floor management.label: Weed control
Orchard floor management.text: Use mulching or herbicides to eliminate weeds; herbicide sprays need 200–400 L water per ha, varying by herbicide type.
Orchard floor management.pdf_text: Herbicide sprays require 200-400 L of water per ha to be effective, and the water volume varies with the herbicide type; use mulching or herbicides to eliminate weeds.

Orchard floor management.label: Floor planning
Orchard floor management.text: Plan tree-row and inter-row management separately and scout weeds.

Orchard floor management.label: Alley sod and covers
Orchard floor management.text: Mow and manage sod or cover crops in the alleys.

Orchard floor management.label: Sucker control
Orchard floor management.text: Remove trunk-base suckers without injuring canopy or fruit.

Environmental stress management.label: Extreme weather and animal protection
Environmental stress management.text: Follow guides for hail, bushfire, drought and wildlife, including bird protection, critical temperature charts and sunburn prevention.
Environmental stress management.pdf_text: Guides for mitigating orchard environmental stress: hail, bushfires, drought, and wildlife. Includes bird protection, critical temperature charts, and sunburn prevention practices.

Environmental stress management.label: Light & heat protection
Environmental stress management.text: Use reflective films and shading such as coloured net; bag fruit against sunburn and environmental damage.
Environmental stress management.pdf_text: Use reflective films and shading such as coloured net; Bagging is also a common management strategy to protect fruit from sunburn and environmental damage.

Environmental stress management.label: Injury diagnosis
Environmental stress management.text: Recognise herbicide, hail, drainage and frost injury and their causes.

Environmental stress management.label: Weather records and recovery
Environmental stress management.text: Keep weather and loss records and recover blocks after flood or fire.

IPDM.label: Monitoring & intervention
IPDM.text: Follow a monitoring strategy with set frequency and symptom descriptions, and take the appropriate action.
IPDM.pdf_text: Refer to monitoring strategy with frequency, symptom description, and appropriate actions.

IPDM.label: Spray application
IPDM.text: Calibrate sprayers and plan sprays for good coverage and compatibility.

IPDM.label: Resistance management
IPDM.text: Rotate modes of action to delay insecticide resistance.

IPDM.label: Natural enemies
IPDM.text: Protect beneficial insects and mites when choosing sprays.

IPDM.label: Birds and animals
IPDM.text: Control birds and vertebrate pests and inspect netting.

IPDM.label: Biosecurity and hygiene
IPDM.text: Keep the orchard clean and watch for exotic pests.

IPDM.label: Organic pest programme
IPDM.text: Use only allowed materials and whole-system methods in certified organic blocks.

IPDM.label: Spray compliance
IPDM.text: Hold accreditation, follow the label and keep spray records.

Disease management.label: Scab and fire blight
Disease management.text: Protect against apple scab and fire blight.

Disease management.label: Root and collar rots
Disease management.text: Recognise and manage root, crown and collar rots.

Disease management.label: Wood and union decline
Disease management.text: Watch for silver leaf, union necrosis and rapid decline.

Disease management.label: Exotic disease watch
Disease management.text: Watch for exotic diseases and report suspect cases.

Disease management.label: Fungicide resistance
Disease management.text: Rotate and mix fungicides to delay resistance.

Disease management.label: Organic disease programme
Disease management.text: Combine organic materials, biocontrol and sanitation against disease.

Modify Landscape.label: Changing variety
Modify Landscape.text: Rework or regraft poor-performing blocks to a better strain.

Modify Landscape.label: Drainage maintenance
Modify Landscape.text: Check and maintain the orchard drainage system.

Tillage.label: Within-row cultivation
Tillage.text: Cultivate within the tree row where needed.

Soil chemical management.label: Soil chemistry correction
Soil chemical management.text: Correct soil acidity and cation balance.

Soil chemical management.label: Soil health assessment
Soil chemical management.text: Assess soil health in the block.

Disease management.label: Replant risk assessment
Disease management.text: Diagnose replant disease and test for nematodes; budget for the risk.

Disease management.label: Site clearing
Disease management.text: Remove old trees and roots cleanly before replanting.

Disease management.label: Replant management
Disease management.text: Choose tolerant rootstocks and build soil biology rather than disinfect.

Modify Landscape.label: Block removal and interval
Modify Landscape.text: Plan replant cycles and account for carbon released when removing blocks.

Modify Landscape.label: Row repositioning
Modify Landscape.text: Plant new rows in the old grass lanes.

Orchard floor management.label: Replant site care
Orchard floor management.text: Protect soil between removal and replanting and grow a nematode-suppressing pre-crop.

IPDM.label: Nematode sampling
IPDM.text: Sample soil and roots for nematodes and replant risk.

Perform Tillage.label: Old tree removal
Perform Tillage.text: Remove old trees and as many roots as possible before replanting.
